scripts.dev: export PATH="$PATH:/opt/flutter/bin:/usr/local/bin"; which flutter >/dev/null 2>&1 && flutter run -d web-server --web-port 3000 --web-hostname 0.0.0.0 --no-wasm-dry-run || npx serve dist -l 3000
scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && if [ -x /opt/flutter/bin/flutter ] || command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then export PATH="$PATH:/opt/flutter/bin:/usr/local/bin"; [ -f pubspec.yaml ] || cd /app/applet; flutter build web --release --no-wasm-dry-run --output=dist; elif [ -d build/web ] && [ -f build/web/index.html ]; then cp -r build/web/* dist/; elif [ -d dist ] && [ -f dist/index.html ]; then echo 'Using prebuilt dist'; else cp -r web/* dist/; fi && test -f dist/index.html
